english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a product warranty, especially one covering repairs during a stated period.

exampleSentences.english: This phone has a one-year warranty, and it can be repaired for free if it breaks.

english.note: Use this for a product warranty, especially when discussing repair or coverage during the warranty period.
